title: Vrykul Armament: native timed reagent cast and Smoldering Forge vignette confirmed; original acquisition and placement unresolved
scope: Code/data research only. User requested comparison against DBC/DB2, Wowhead and other GitHub sources, prioritizing original behavior over an authored restoration. No WoW client operation.
status: Expanded public-source research remains unresolved for original acquisition, forge entry/position and retail availability. The speculative restoration remains withdrawn; no gameplay implementation or World migration is delivered.
previous_evidence_preserved: The previous audit's brew repair, weighted objectives and client limitations remain unchanged. This follow-up expands its unresolved armament note; it does not declare the armament route retail-verified, unused or removed.

confirmed_native_data.important_correction: Inspecting only181859's instant parent and its trigger effect missed181858's1.5-second cast and native reagent cost. An immediate custom item deletion/credit implementation does not reproduce this chain and was rejected.
confirmed_native_data.native_dispatch_inspection: Spell::EffectTriggerSpell in SpellEffects.cpp switches to TRIGGERED_NONE when the child CalcCastTime is nonzero, and effect160 forwards the child's cast time. Preserve the native cast/cost path if a future restoration is justified. Effect134 uses group event credit; personal-only credit is an authored change, not an established original requirement.
confirmed_native_data.other_named_spells: 193965/193971 are self dummy auras, not item-creation effects. World creature_template_addon applies them to98516/98517 Stolen Vrykul Armament, which are separate content and were left unchanged.

expanded_public_search.search_limits: Exact names, numeric IDs, GitHub code searches with and without fork qualifiers, repository trees, historical SQL archives, public client CSVs, current database pages and original-era gameplay video leads were examined. Search indexes are incomplete, numeric matches can be incidental, fork copies are not independent evidence, and sampled video frames cannot prove that an optional route never existed. No source supports the withdrawn35% drop rate or invented900383 forge/spawn.
expanded_public_search.decision: Keep the route unresolved rather than add a guessed restoration. Need positive original evidence identifying acquisition, actual forge entry/position and cast route. Existing other credit paths and prior regression evidence remain unchanged; this research does not declare the whole quest/client verified.
